caption: The drawing depicts a carved sculpture of a bison, positioned on a rectangular base. The bison is facing slightly to the right, with its head lowered and legs bent as if in a stance of movement or readiness. Its horns curve downward and outward, and its facial features, including the nose and eyes, are clearly defined. The mane is textured with wavy, carved lines, contrasting with the smoother surface of the body. The tail is curved and positioned upwards, and the legs are robust, with clearly delineated hooves. The overall color palette of the drawing consists of light beige and brown tones, with darker shading around the mane, horns, and base to emphasize texture and depth. The background is plain and unmarked, bringing focus to the sculpture itself.
title: Buffalo
